question: Can noise and/or full-vocabulary KL regularization prevent complement-DAS family memorization and produce a moved rank-one axis that improves on pooled step zero across complete construction families?
initialization: frozen pooled-aligned axis; step zero remains eligible

crossvalidation: train complete v8, select complete v10
train complete v10, select complete v8
family_protocol.sealed: v11 opened once after arm and step-count selection

objective: All arms optimize margin/L15 match plus complement inertness with hard per-panel target-retention limits. KL arms additionally optimize full-vocabulary match and complement KL/vector inertness. Noise arms use antithetic tangent perturbations. Every arm is selected by the same six-term held-out-family score.
selection: Choose the arm minimizing worst complete-family validation score across both folds, breaking ties by mean score then arm order. Choose final update count from fold checkpoints, refit that arm on v8+v10, and evaluate v11 once.

predictions.pred_a_authority_disjointness_instrument: Authorities match; v8/v10/v11 are row-disjoint complete families; manual reader closures <=1e-4; all metrics finite; observed forwards <=1800.
predictions.pred_b_regularization_wins_both_family_f: Noise, KL, or noise+KL has a nonzero feasible checkpoint that beats no-reg and pooled step zero on each held-out family.
predictions.pred_c_regularized_axes_are_cross_family: The two selected fold axes have absolute cosine >=.80.
predictions.pred_d_regularized_refit_beats_pooled_on: The preregistered refit is target-feasible and strictly improves both mean and worst six-term v11 panel score over pooled step zero.
predictions.pred_e_improvement_is_not_target_sacrifi: The refit improves full-vocabulary match+inertness on both v11 panels while remaining within every hard margin/L15 retention limit.

terminal_policy.objective_miss: A passes, moved checkpoints exist, but pooled step zero wins family validation
terminal_policy.rank_one_inadequate: A passes but no moved checkpoint is target-feasible
terminal_policy.residual_family_memorization: A passes and a regularized arm wins folds but fails sealed v11
